pipeline:
name: Test Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Syntax Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Check JavaScript syntax
        run: node --check src/components/add.cjs && node --check tests/add.test.cjs

  test:
    name: Unit and Component Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    needs: lint

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  report:
    name: Test Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: always()

    steps:
      - name: Publish summary
        env:
          TEST_RESULT: ${{ needs.test.result }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Test Execution Summary"
            echo
            echo "* Test: ${TEST_RESULT}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

          if [[ "$TEST_RESULT" != "success" ]]; then
            exit 1
          fi
